<HR  SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>SHELL FURTHER REDUCES ITS INTEREST IN WOODSIDE </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>The Hague, November&nbsp;13, 2017. Royal Dutch Shell plc (&#147;Shell&#148;) announces an agreement to sell part of its stake in Woodside Petroleum Limited
(&#147;Woodside&#148;) to equity investors. </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Shell&#146;s subsidiary, Shell Energy Holdings Australia Limited (&#147;SEHAL&#148;), has entered into an
underwriting agreement with two investment banks, for the sale of 71.6&nbsp;million shares in Woodside, representing 64.0% of its interest in Woodside and 8.5% of the issued capital in Woodside, at a price of A$31.10 per share, resulting in total <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">pre-tax</FONT> proceeds of approximately $1.7&nbsp;billion (A$2.2 billion). The sale is expected to complete on November&nbsp;14, 2017. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Shell&#146;s Chief Financial Officer, Jessica Uhl, said &#147;This sale is another step towards the completion of our three-year $30&nbsp;billion divestment
programme, which is an important part of our strategy to reshape Shell, to deliver a world class investment case, and to strengthen our financial framework. Proceeds from the sale will contribute to reducing our net debt.&#148; </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Upon completion of the sale, SEHAL will continue to own a 4.8% interest in Woodside. SEHAL has agreed that it will not dispose of any of its remaining shares
in Woodside for a minimum of 90 days from completion of the sell-down, with limited customary exceptions. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><U>Notes for editors </U></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Outside of its interest in Woodside, Shell has the following interests in Australia: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top">Shell Energy Australia (Shell 100% interest) </TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Recent history of Shell&#146;s investment in Woodside: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">In November 2010 Shell sold 10% of the issued capital of Woodside, retaining a 24.27% interest in Woodside. This interest was further diluted to 23.08% because
of Shell&#146;s decision not to participate in Woodside&#146;s dividend <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">re-investment</FONT> programme. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">In June 2014,
Shell sold approximately 78.27&nbsp;million shares in Woodside representing 9.5% of Woodside&#146;s issued share capital, retaining an interest of 13.58%, This interest was further diluted to 13.28% because of Shell&#146;s decision not to
participate in Woodside&#146;s dividend <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">re-investment</FONT> programme. </P>

<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">During the second quarter 2016, Shell management concluded that a change in Shell&#146;s level of involvement
over Woodside&#146;s financial and operating policy decisions resulted in Shell no longer having significant influence. Its classification was therefore changed from an associate (carrying amount: $2,144 million) to an investment in securities
(carrying amount at fair value: at change in classification in Q2 2016 $2,442 million). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Enquiries </B></P>

Media Relations: +1 832 337 4355 </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Cautionary note </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The companies in which Royal Dutch Shell plc directly and indirectly owns investments are separate legal entities. In this announcement &#147;Shell&#148;,
&#147;Shell group&#148; and &#147;Royal Dutch Shell&#148; are sometimes used for convenience where references are made to Royal Dutch Shell plc and its subsidiaries in general. Likewise, the words &#147;we&#148;, &#147;us&#148; and &#147;our&#148;
are also used to refer to subsidiaries in general or to those who work for them. These expressions are also used where no useful purpose is served by identifying the particular company or companies. &#145;&#145;Subsidiaries&#146;&#146;, &#147;Shell
subsidiaries&#148; and &#147;Shell companies&#148; as used in this announcement refer to companies over which Royal Dutch Shell plc&nbsp;either directly or indirectly has control. Entities and unincorporated arrangements over which Shell has joint
control are generally referred to as &#147;joint ventures&#148; and &#147;joint operations&#148; respectively.&nbsp;Entities over which Shell has significant influence but neither control nor joint control are referred to as &#147;associates&#148;.
The term &#147;Shell interest&#148; is used for convenience to indicate the direct and/or indirect ownership interest held by Shell in a venture, partnership or company, after exclusion of all third-party interest. </P>

<HR  SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>SHELL UPSIZES SELL DOWN OF SHARES IN WOODSIDE </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>The Hague, November&nbsp;13, 2017. Further to the announcement on November&nbsp;13, 2017, Royal Dutch Shell plc (&#147;Shell&#148;)</B> confirms that,
following strong demand from institutional investors, Shell Energy Holdings Australia Limited (&#147;SEHAL&#148;) has upsized its previously announced agreement to sell shares in Woodside Petroleum Limited (&#147;Woodside&#148;). A total of
111.8&nbsp;million shares were agreed to be sold, representing 13.28% of the issued share capital of Woodside and the entirety of SEHAL&#146;s total shareholding in Woodside, for total <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">pre-tax</FONT> proceeds of
$2.7&nbsp;billion (A$3.5 billion). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Completion is expected to take place on November&nbsp;14, 2017, with settlement expected on November&nbsp;16, 2017.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Enquiries </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Investor Relations</B></P>

&#147;Shell&#148;, &#147;Shell group&#148; and &#147;Royal Dutch Shell&#148; are sometimes used for convenience where references are made to Royal Dutch Shell plc and its subsidiaries in general. Likewise, the words &#147;we&#148;, &#147;us&#148;
and &#147;our&#148; are also used to refer to subsidiaries in general or to those who work for them. These expressions are also used where no useful purpose is served by identifying the particular company or companies.
&#145;&#145;Subsidiaries&#146;&#146;, &#147;Shell subsidiaries&#148; and &#147;Shell companies&#148; as used in this announcement refer to companies over which Royal Dutch Shell plc&nbsp;either directly or indirectly has control. Entities and
unincorporated arrangements over which Shell has joint control are generally referred to as &#147;joint ventures&#148; and &#147;joint operations&#148; respectively.&nbsp;Entities over which Shell has significant influence but neither control nor
joint control are referred to as &#147;associates&#148;. The term &#147;Shell interest&#148; is used for convenience to indicate the direct and/or indirect ownership interest held by Shell in a venture, partnership or company, after exclusion of all
third-party interest. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This announcement contains forward-looking statements concerning the financial condition, results of operations and businesses of
